items.text: Kwathi ebona amaxuku wenyukela entabeni; esehlezi phansi abafundi bakhe beza kuye.
Babusisiwe abangabayanga emoyeni, ngoba umbuso wezulu ungowabo.
Babusisiwe abamnene, ngoba bazakudla ilifa lomhlaba.
Babusisiwe abalambela bomele ukulunga, ngoba bazakusuthiswa.
Babusisiwe abalenhliziyo ezihlambulukileyo, ngoba bazakubona uNkulunkulu.
Babusisiwe abalamulayo, ngoba bazakuthiwa ngabantwana bakaNkulunkulu.
Babusisiwe abazingelwa ngenxa yokulunga, ngoba umbuso wezulu ungowabo.
Lina libusisiwe, nxa abantu belithuka ngenxa yami, belizingela, bekhuluma okubi konke ngani, beqamba amanga.
Thokozani, lithabe kakhulu, ngoba umvuzo wenu mkhulu ezulwini; ngoba ngokunjalo babazingela abaprofethi abalandulelayo.
Lina lilitshwayi emhlabeni; kodwa uba itshwayi seliduma, lizakuvuselelwa ngani na? Kalisasizi lutho, kuphela ukulahlwa ngaphandle, linyathelwe ngabantu.
Lina liyikukhanya emhlabeni. Umuzi owakhiwe phezu kwentaba ungesitheke.
Labantu kabalumathisi isibane basibeke ngaphansi kwesitsha, kodwa basibeka esiqobaneni, ukuze sibakhanyisele bonke abasendlini.
Kunjaloke kakukhanye ukukhanya kwenu phambi kwabantu ukuba babone imisebenzi yenu emihle, badumise uYihlo osezulwini.
Lingathi ngize ukuchitha umlayo ingabe abaprofethi; angizanga ukuchitha, kodwa ngize ukugcwalisa.
Ngoba ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Kuze kudlule izulu lomhlaba kakusoze kudlule ibadlana libe linye ingabe lecwatshana libe linye lomlayo, kuze kwenzakale konke.
Ngakho owaphula owodwa kulimilayo emincinyane, afundise abantu njalo, uzakuthiwa ngomncinyane embusweni wezulu; kodwa oyenzayo ayifundise, lowo uzakuthiwa mkhulu embusweni wezulu.
Ngoba ngithi kini: Aluba ukulunga kwenu kungadluli okwababhali lokwabaFarisi, kalisoze lingene embusweni wezulu.
Lizwile ukuthi kwathiwa kwabasendulo: Ungabulali; ilowo lalowo obulalayo uzakuba lecala lokuthonisiswa.

Kodwa mina ngithi kini: Ilowo lalowo othukuthelela umfowabo uzakuba lecala lokuthonisiswa; lothuka umfowabo uzakuba lecala emphakathini. Lotshoyo ukuthi: Sithutha ndini! uzakuba lecala lokuphoselwa esihogweni somlilo.
Ngakhoke uba uletha umnikelo wakho ealtareni, ubusukhumbula ulapho ukuthi umfowenu ulesikhwili lawe,
tshiya lapho umnikelo wakho phambi kwealtare, uhambe ubuyisane lomfowenu, anduba uze unikele umnikelo wakho.
Phangisa uzwane laye omangalelene lawe lapho lisesendleleni, funa omangalelene lawe akunikele kumthonisisi, umthonisisi akunikele enxuseni, uphoselwe entolongweni.
Ngiqinisile ngithi kuwe: Kawusoze uphume khona uze ukhokhe indibilitshi yokucina.
Kodwa mina ngithi kini: Ilowo lalowo okhangela owesifazana amkhanuke, usefebile laye enhliziyweni yakhe.
Uba ilihlo lakho lokunene likukhubekisa, likhuphe, ulilahle; ngoba kungcono kuwe ukuba kubhubhe sibe sinye sezitho zakho kulokuba wonke umzimba wakho uphoselwe esihogweni.
Uba isandla sakho sokunene sikukhubekisa, siqume usilahle; ngoba kungcono kuwe ukuba kubhubhe sibe sinye sezitho zakho kulokuba wonke umzimba wakho uphoselwe esihogweni.
Kwathiwa: Ilowo olahla umkakhe kamnike incwadi yesahlukaniso.
Kodwa mina ngithi kini: Ilowo lalowo olahla umkakhe kungengenxa yokufeba, umenza afebe; lomthathayo olahliweyo uyafeba.
Lizwile futhi kwathiwa kwabasendulo: Ungafungi amanga, kodwa gcwalisa izifungo zakho eNkosini.
Kodwa mina ngithi kini: Lingafungi lakanye, loba izulu, ngoba liyisihlalo sobukhosi sikaNkulunkulu;
loba umhlaba, ngoba uyisigcabha senyawo zakhe; loba iJerusalema, ngoba lingumuzi weNkosi enkulu.
Ungafungi lekhanda lakho, ngoba ungelwenze unwele lalunye lube mhlophe ingabe lube mnyama.
Ilizwi lenu kalibe ngelokuthi: Yebo; loba: Atshi. Okudlula lokho kuvela komubi.
Lizwile kwathiwa: Ilihlo lenanwa ngelihlo, lezinyo ngezinyo;
kodwa mina ngithi kini: Lingamelani lokoniwa, kodwa uba umuntu ekuwakala esihlathini sokunene, mphendulele lesinye.
Uba umuntu ekumangalela ukuze akuthathele isigqoko sakho, mnike lengubo.
Lalowo okubamba ngamandla ukuba uhambe ikhilomitha libe linye, hamba laye amakhilomitha abe mabili.
Mnike ocela kuwe, ungamfulatheli ofisa ukweboleka kuwe.
Lizwile kwathiwa: Wothanda umakhelwane wakho, uzonde isitha sakho.
Kodwa mina ngithi kini: Thandani izitha zenu, libakhulekele abalizingelayo,
ukuba libe ngabantwana bakaYihlo osezulwini; ngoba yena uyaliphumisela ilanga lakhe ababi labahle, alinisele izulu abalungileyo labangalunganga.
Ngoba aluba lithanda labo abalithandayo, lilomvuzo bani na? Kabenzi njalo labathelisi na?
Futhi uba libingelela abafowenu bodwa, lenzani okukhulu okudlula okwabanye na? Kabenzi njalo labathelisi yini?
Ngakho lina wobani ngabapheleleyo, njengokuba uYihlo osezulwini ephelele.
